head: 1fd463f4de4bbff659f4e402c6f31138c49765b4
scope: Real tier Match/Inferior, junk rules/display/marks and asynchronous sell owners; item/classification/API facts and immediate versus delayed-provider publication are mocked. This fixture does not execute the external Syndicator addon or a real crafting recipe. Existing complete-suite craft/provider checks supply complementary desktop coverage.
scenario: 5client adapter models x2publication timings x3combat kinds; remembered/vendor/recipe upgrades without bags, gains/losses/equal tiers/other kinds/unusable tiers, crafted outputs, three-tier fallback before provider callback, live eligibility without generation change, low-level vs inferior toggles, manual lists/restock, metadata gaps and actual simulated sale acknowledgements.
warmup: Fresh Lua process per recorded run. Each isolated scenario initializes its fixture and completes one inferior pass before the100pairs of repeated verdict/display checks. Those initial transitions and process startup are included in the full operation/wall totals. No native warm-up/capture was performed.
duration: Deterministic event/operation sequence; simulated seller capture1s(no upgrade) and2s(delivered upgrade), repeated per30scenarios. Host wall time is diagnostic, not native operation latency.
repetitions: Five alternating baseline/final pairs and five alternating redundant-count-control/final pairs after separate warmups.
profiler: Desktop fixture counters only; native CPU profiler unchanged/unqueried; counter overhead included, native overhead unmeasured.
hardware: Existing Windows PC i7-12700F,34164105216bytes RAM; host load uncontrolled; GPU/rendering not exercised.
settings: Isolated test rules/modes; no live SavedVariables/profile/input/profiler mutations. External checkpoint copies only accessible on-disk settings; unsaved memory excluded.
nativeClientBuild: Not captured; fixture family labels select adapters, not installed/runtime acceptance.
interpretation: Existing tier-reference cache retains only candidate lists by inventory/metadata generation. Current highest-tier checks skip equal/lower candidates without replacement counts. Lower-tier decisions revalidate live bag-only copies and usability. No new polling/events/hooks/frames/timers or saved roots. Different transition work is required by the new policy; no native speed/FPS or allocation claim.
